CardDescription.DefaultText: A sheep that recently gave birth. Use a clay bowl to milk it daily, shear it for wool, or slaughter it. Below a quarter Nourishment it grows no wool and gives no milk.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Slaughter the sheep for meat, hide and offal. A sheep whose Wool bar is at least half full gives a fleece-on pelt (Fresh Fur) in place of the hide.
Use a clay bowl to collect fresh milk. The sheep needs time to replenish milk between milkings.
Feed the sheep grass or hay to keep it well fed: well-fed sheep regrow wool and milk faster.

PassiveEffects.EffectName: Underfed (no wool or milk below 72 Nourishment)
Winter Hunger (Nourishment drains twice as fast outside the pen)
